rpgprogression.attribute.strength.toolti: Increases melee weapon damage. Does not change the item itself.
rpgprogression.attribute.endurance.toolt: Increases maximum stamina and unlocks inventory slots. Reduces all stamina consumption by 1% per point above the starting value, up to 30%.
rpgprogression.attribute.agility.tooltip: Increases movement speed and accelerates bow draw and crossbow charging. Diminishing returns prevent instant shots.
rpgprogression.attribute.vitality.toolti: Increases maximum health and resistance to physical damage and poisoning.
rpgprogression.attribute.intelligence.to: Unlocks crafting recipes and increases elemental and magic defense. Every 5 points above starting Intelligence adds 1 mana capacity, up to 8.

rpgprogression.skills.details: Click the icon to unlock the skill
rpgprogression.skills.description.epicfi: Roll in the movement direction, evading incoming attacks during the dodge. Uses the shared stamina pool.
A short sidestep in the movement direction that evades incoming attacks and uses shared stamina.
Hold right-click to guard against frontal attacks. Repeated blocks increase stamina consumption.
Time a guard just before impact to avoid stamina consumption. Also allows guarding ranged attacks.
Reduces stamina consumption and repeated-guard penalties. Partially guards explosions, fire, magic and projectiles.
Builds stacking resistance to a damage type that recently hit the player.
Killing a mob immediately releases the shared stamina regeneration delay and briefly prevents new actions from restarting it.
Missing health increases attack damage and attack speed. The extra attack speed has a limit.
Consecutive strikes against one enemy build a damage bonus. Striking another target resets the stacks.
Successfully dodging an attack restores innate weapon skill charge.
Killing an enemy with an innate weapon skill restores some weapon charge.
Allows dodging while being hit or out of stamina, and canceling attack motions with a dodge.
Being hit while preparing an attack spends part of current stamina and temporarily grants stun resistance.
When stamina is insufficient, skills can use health instead. Costs and shortages use the shared stamina pool.
Allows executing an innate weapon skill with incomplete charge by paying from the shared stamina pool.
Killing your target restores a portion of missing stamina directly to the shared pool.
Increases weapon attack speed. Its capacity and regeneration bonuses apply to the shared stamina system.
Dodging just before an attack hits refunds spent stamina to the shared pool.
Increases damage against the enemy that recently hurt you. Killing that target grants a temporary damage bonus that gradually fades.
Slam into the ground after falling. Height increases damage and stamina cost; an excessive fall can hurt you when stamina is insufficient.
Blocking, parrying and dodging build stacks. Enough stacks allow a stunning counterattack.
Gather energy and launch yourself in a chosen direction. Reduces the next fall damage.
Allows additional jumps in midair. Their number follows the Epic Fight skill parameters.
rpgprogression.skills.description.parcoo: Crawl and pass through low openings.
Slide during fast running to pass under low obstacles.
Hide inside suitable blocks such as leaves.
Charge a jump before taking off to reach greater height.
Grab a block ledge and hang from it.
Pull yourself up onto a ledge you are hanging from.
Climb suitable poles.
Perform a controlled slide down a wall.
Hang beneath a suitable surface and move along it.
Travel along a zipline.
Unlock ParCool fast running, which uses the shared stamina pool.
Swim faster than normal.
Quickly vault over low obstacles.
A correctly timed landing roll softens a fall.
Perform special jumps while moving.
Perform a longer running jump.
Quickly dodge in a chosen direction.
Dive forward with a jump and transition into prone movement.
Control your posture while in free fall.
Run along a wall for a short time.
Jump away from a wall.
Run upward on a wall.
Launch away from a wall after running on it.
Use a grappling hook for movement.
